examples: The early arrival of the bride created a stir.

senses.definition: The fact of reaching a particular point in time.
examples: He celebrated the arrival of payday with a shopping spree.

quotes.text:
O gentlemen, the time of life is short!
To spend that shortness basely were too long,
If life did ride upon a dial’s point,
Still ending at the arrival of an hour.
